messages:
eval-bot: nightly-evals: model:redwood-4xq-int8 failed quality gate on prompt_set: longform_core (regression 6.3% > 2%). failing examples attached.

jess: saw the alert. which variant was pushed in the bring-up?

mike: that was the int8-quant variant we promoted to staging yesterday for perf testing (batch-optimized kernel build).

tom: quick summary: nightly evals spike started at ~02:10 UTC. failure clustering around prompts with multi-paragraph reasoning and long context (>=1200 tokens).

jess: can someone dump a couple of raw generations for the failing prompts?

mike: pasted two diffs:
```
--- fp16_baseline.out
+++ int8_variant.out
@@
-...the policy should include a human review step and clear escalation.
+...the policy includes human review but stops mid-sentence.
```

rachel: infra logs show no GPU OOMs. latency improved ~20% on int8 but error rate on longform up.

tom: hypothesis: KV-cache or rotary embedding interaction with the new int8 dequant path for sequence lengths >1024. saw similar in a convo in eng-runtime last year.

mike: I reproduced locally: with sequence_length=1300 the int8 build produced truncated/garbled tokens after a certain step. FP16 is fine. attaching a small repro script:
```
# repro snippet
python repro.py --model redwood-4xq --quant int8 --seq 1300 --prompt_file failing.txt
```

jess: thanks — can you capture perf counters / kernel names when repro runs? might be a fused attention kernel.

mike: yup. kernel that shows up is attention_fused_v2_int8, timings spike and output entropy jumps right when kv_cache write happens.

tom: root cause (prelim): quantized dequantization zero-point applied with per-tensor scale instead of per-channel for the rotary + KV layout we use. for long contexts the accumulation saturates and later tokens collapse. looks like a regression introduced by the new quant path in compile step.

jess: that explains why short prompts are OK. good catch. what's the mitigation path?

mike: immediate: roll back int8 to the last known good build on staging and production (re-deploy FP16 variant). then block scheduled canary rollouts for that int8 artifact.

deploy-bot: deploy request: rollback redwood-4xq-int8 -> redwood-4xq-fp16 at 1745128000 UTC (requested by mike).

rachel: I'll schedule the rollback to prod-canaries at 1745128000 and disable auto-promote for that artifact id.

tom: medium-term: patch quant compile to use per-channel scales for rotary/KV codepath, add unit test that runs sequences > 1024 with random weights to detect saturations.

jess: add a gating rule: any quantized variant must pass the longform_core prompt_set with regression < 1.5% before canary. also add a targeted CI job: "quant-sanity-longform" that runs on any quant compile PR.

mike: I will open a PR with the dequant fix + fuzz test. will include a small benchmark harness:
```
tools/quant_sanity/longform_check.sh --artifact $ART --seqs 512,1024,1300
```

tom: action items:
- mike: open dequant fix PR + include kernel-level test (owner: mike, ETA: 48h)
- rachel: schedule rollback and disable artifact auto-promote (owner: rachel, ETA: 1h)
- jess: add gating rule to nightly-evals config and update docs (owner: jess, ETA: 24h)
- tom: add targeted prompt set to CI and ticket infra to collect failing generations (owner: tom, ETA: 24h)

jess: also let's add a canary policy: quantized artifacts must start at 0% traffic, then 5% for 12h with continuous evals before any larger rollout. I'll write the policy.

mike: noted. I'll also run a quick blackbox fuzz across seq lengths to catch other kernel edgecases.

rachel: rollback scheduled and running prechecks now. I'll post updates when it's done.

deploy-bot: rollback complete for redwood-4xq-int8 -> redwood-4xq-fp16 at 1745128100 UTC.

jess: thanks everyone. keep updates in this thread; once Mike's fix lands we should re-run the full nightly and flag a safe window for a renewed canary. :thumbsup:

mike: will do. posting PR link when ready.
